0022600015.text: The Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 5th in the East, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Washington Wizards (2-3, 3rd in the Southeast and 1 game back, 9th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in their sixth game of the season, a regular-season Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), and Dennis Schroder is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Tre Johnson day-to-day with Achilles soreness, and the Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, following a 4-0 sweep of Washington in 2025-26.
